issue.title: Finish E3: make live failure triage actually run, fix owner matching, and prove it on athena
issue.description: An agent's `sase tool run check` on athena records a triage for every settled named run and continues past all-KNOWN/FLAKY stages to `test (scoped)`. Possible owners are suggested only when a bead really names the failing file. The E3 landing criteria are proven live, so the E3 land agent can close `sase-18j`.

issue.title: Send wire-valid evidence, store triage diagnostics, and clear the E3 stragglers
issue.description: triage-inputs: make the selection-record gatherer emit wire-valid evidence (failures extracted into items) for both settle and the mid-run stage verb. Persist dropped-input and failure diagnostics. Privatize stage_decision, fix the stopd marker, and fix the linked-repo monitor lookup. Add real-binding and smoke regressions that feed a real-shaped full-run selection record.

issue.title: Match possible owners on file identity, not on shared path tokens
issue.description: core-owner-match: in sase-core only, replace the any-3-char-token substring owner match with a path-level match against a candidate's location plus a guarded file-name title match. Record what matched, and add the sase-191.3 probe as a regression fixture.

issue.title: Pin the owner-matching core and verify owners on live candidates
issue.description: owner-pin: move sase-core-revision.txt to a pushed sase-core commit that contains the new owner matcher, add a real-binding owner round trip, and re-run the owner probe against the live bead candidates.

issue.title: Prove E3's landing criteria live on athena
issue.description: live-acceptance: run the live athena acceptance, re-run and hand-audit the precision backtest, cross-check sase tool failures against the ledger, confirm the check digest, measure the post-landing baseline, and record the DoD checklist on sase-18j.
